raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Business Analyst with 7 years of Capital Markets experience specializing in Securities operations, Trade Lifecycle, Reference Data, Business Analysis, Regulatory Reporting and Digital Transformation. Experienced in requirements gathering, stakeholder management, Agile delivery, process mapping, UAT, data migration, and end-to-end implementation across Equities, Fixed Income, FX, Funds, Commodities, and Derivatives.
EXPERIENCE: SOCIETE GENERALE
2023 - NOW
Business Analyst
Led requirement analysis for SocGen's Prime Brokerage platform (10M EUR transformation initiative), collaborating with trading, risk, and operations stakeholders to define business needs and translate them into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and business documentation. Ochestrated migration of 18 downstream applications from legacy platforms to Azure Data Lake, ensuring seamless data transition, validation, and uninterrupted business operations. Designed and implemented pricing automation and validation control framework, ensuring high-quality market data ingestion, reducing pricing errors, and eliminating manual checks equivalent to 1 FTE daily. Spearheaded automation of Equities, Funds, Options, and Futures contract creation in our system, reducing manual effort by 30% and saving 1 FTE daily while accelerating time-to-market. Owned end-to-end reference data lifecycle (creation, amendment, maintenance) across Derivatives, Equities, FX, and Commodities, ensuring 100% compliance with exchange and regulatory standards. Drove end-to-end migration of referential data from Oracle-based legacy systems to Azure Data Lake, contributing to significant infrastructure cost optimization and scalable enterprise data access. Managed JIRA backlogs, sprint planning, user story refinement, delivery tracking, RAID logs, dependency management, governance reporting, and executive stakeholder communication. Facilitated stakeholder workshops to elicit business requirements, perform impact analysis, and support end-to-end solution delivery across cross-functional teams. Demonstrated strong functional expertise across Cash Equities, FX, Derivatives, Commodities, Funds, Indices, and OTC products, supporting front-to-back trade lifecycle processes, data governance, reconciliations, regulatory reporting, and transformation initiatives. Collaborated with Operations, Technology, and Business teams to support front-to-back trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, validation, settlement, lifecycle events, and exception management across multiple asset classes.
2019 - 2023 Senior Analyst
Managed end-to-end onboarding and creating of Equities, Funds, FX , Indices, Futures, Options, and Commodity Derivatives across global markets, ensuring compliance with Bloomberg, Reuters, Exchange, GMI, and market-specific
regulatory standards. Performed reference data management and static data enrichment, resolving data quality issues and ensuring accuracy across downstream trading and risk systems. Conducted daily market price validation and exception management, investigating pricing discrepancies and ensuring accurate valuation data across asset classes. Managed corporate actions lifecycle for Equities and Derivatives, including symbol changes, stock splits, mergers, instrument ID updates, and strike price adjustments. Supported regulatory reporting initiatives for MiFID II and EMIR by maintaining accurate security reference data and ensuring compliance with reporting requirements. Played a key role in the EUREX NEXTGEN migration, successfully supporting trade rebooking, product onboarding, and implementation of daily and weekly expiry instruments with no downstream impact.
raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS
Business Analysis, Requirements Gathering, Functional Specifications, User Stories, JIRA, Agile/Scrum, SQL, Data Reconciliation, UAT, Release Management , Trade Lifecycle, Equities, FX, Derivatives, Regulatory Reporting, Root Cause Analysis, Bloomberg, Reuters, Excel, Al Tools, Copilot， ADLC

2016 - 2019
Bachelor of Commerce Vijaya College - Bangalore
